help:
usage: st web [-h] {search,research,fetch,benchmark} ...

Run centralized web research using Agent Hub's shared tool stack.

positional arguments:
  {search,research,fetch,benchmark}
    search              Search the public web.
    research            Search first, then fetch one result through the shared
                        web stack.
    fetch               Fetch and extract a webpage.
    benchmark           Run deterministic local web fetch benchmarks.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
help.benchmark:
usage: st web benchmark [-h] [--iterations ITERATIONS] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS]
                        [--compact]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --iterations ITERATIONS
  --max-chars MAX_CHARS
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON
help.fetch:
usage: st web fetch [-h] [--url URL] [--max-chars MAX_CHARS]
                    [--focus-query FOCUS_QUERY] [--backend {auto,direct,jina}]
                    [--compact]
                    [url_arg]

positional arguments:
  url_arg               HTTP or HTTPS URL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL             HTTP or HTTPS URL
  --max-chars MAX_CHARS
                        Maximum content characters to return
  --focus-query FOCUS_QUERY
                        Optional question/topic used to focus large pages
                        before truncation
  --backend {auto,direct,jina}
                        Page fetch backend
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON
help.research:
usage: st web research [-h] [--query QUERY] [--max-results MAX_RESULTS]
                       [--result-index RESULT_INDEX]
                       [--search-type {text,news}] [--timelimit {d,w,m,y}]
                       [--max-chars MAX_CHARS] [--focus-query FOCUS_QUERY]
                       [--backend {auto,direct,jina}] [--compact]
                       [query_arg]

positional arguments:
  query_arg             Research query

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --query QUERY         Research query
  --max-results, --limit MAX_RESULTS
                        Max search results to consider
  --result-index RESULT_INDEX
                        1-based result rank to fetch
  --search-type {text,news}
                        Search scope
  --timelimit {d,w,m,y}
                        Optional search recency filter
  --max-chars MAX_CHARS
                        Maximum fetched content characters to return
  --focus-query FOCUS_QUERY
                        Optional question/topic used to focus the fetched page
                        before truncation
  --backend {auto,direct,jina}
                        Page fetch backend
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON
help.search:
usage: st web search [-h] [--query QUERY] [--max-results MAX_RESULTS]
                     [--search-type {text,news}] [--timelimit {d,w,m,y}]
                     [--compact]
                     [query_arg]

positional arguments:
  query_arg             Search query

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --query QUERY         Search query
  --max-results, --limit MAX_RESULTS
                        Max results to return
  --search-type {text,news}
                        Search scope
  --timelimit {d,w,m,y}
                        Optional search recency filter
  --compact, --raw      Emit compact single-line JSON instead of pretty JSON

summary: Public web search, research, and fetch through Agent Hub.

precautions: Uses Agent Hub's supported web-research executable and owner-managed credentials.
Default ST output writes a local details artifact; --raw emits the owner's JSON.
Use --backend direct for deterministic local benchmark verification.
usage.when: research public web sources; use search or fetch for a known page
